93: // enqueueBrokerTriggers returns an event handler function that enqueues all the
94: // Triggers belonging to the Broker passed in. It is extracted into a named
95: // function so that the enqueue behavior can be unit tested independently of the
96: // controller wiring.
97: func enqueueBrokerTriggers(logger *zap.SugaredLogger, triggerLister v1.TriggerLister, impl *controller.Impl) func(obj interface{}) {
98: 	return func(obj interface{}) {
99: 		for _, t := range getBrokerTriggers(logger, triggerLister, obj) {
100: 			impl.Enqueue(t)
101: 		}
102: 	}
103: }
